title: Weak and Strong Convergence of an Implicit Iteration for Hemi-Contractive Semigroups in Banach Spaces
summary: We study an implicit iteration for approximating common fixed points of strongly continuous semigroups on closed convex subsets of real Banach spaces. Under a stepwise Lipschitz restriction and hemi-contractivity relative to the common fixed point set, we establish well-definedness and Fej% ér monotonicity of the iteration. In reflexive Banach spaces satisfying Opial's condition, we obtain a sufficient condition for weak convergence based on a normalized residual estimate, uniform continuity at zero along the generated sequence, and demiclosedness at fixed positive times.
